title: Challenge me
description: Asks the principal to challenge the requester to present a credential under the schema `schema`. The agent answers an admitted overture by sending an IPEX apply, whose p is the exn SAID of the batch that carried the overture. On completed, the result is the apply, as {said}; whether the presentation satisfies the principal is a later matter of IPEX, not of this overture.

schema.description: The SAID of the schema of the credential the requester offers to present.
